summary: Frontend-only verification of Scope Calculator v2.1 Deploy 1 (P0 only). All 8 review scenarios PASS end-to-end in preview (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Owner login + in-app sidebar nav to Scope Calculator. Scenarios: (1) P0-3 Specialty-only with 3BR pkg + labor + 300–499lb custom → mode indicator 'Specialty-only job', scope-specialty-prompt visible, crew=3 (not 4), Final=$650, Deposit=$162.50, Labor $390 line, Trip fee (labor only) × 1, no $850 nor $2,075. (2) P0-1+P0-2 large labor (Garage2car/Basements/Storage/Living/Family all Packed, miles=0) → no scope-trucks-banner, scope-labor-no-truck shown, truck SVG absent, crew=10, Final=$5,850, Deposit=$1,462.50, Trip fee × 1 (not ×3/×4). (3) P0-4 800lb+ custom → scope-blocker-card shown, no final/band/deposit, scope-save-btn ENABLED with label 'Save for assessment'; save with label 'TEST_QA Assessment 800lb' → success toast 'Saved for on-site assessment — the scope is kept, no dollar amount is stored'; saved-scopes row shows 'assessment' (no dollar figure). (4) P0-1 heavy 2-truck household (7 rooms Avg + std bed x2 + upright piano, miles=12, 1 flight each side) → crew=4 (not 6), billable man-hours=32.2, labor line '32.2 mh × $65.00', trucks-banner visible (weight-driven, expected). (5) P0-5 mileage rate 6.00 (miles=150 same rooms no piano) → scope-mileage-note reads 'Mileage — 130 mi beyond the first 20 × $6.00/mi · +$780', crew=4; Settings 'Rate per extra mile' shows 6. (6) Settings capacity group present with scope-maxCrewPerDay-input=12, scope-targetHoursOnSite-input=8, scope-maxHoursOnSite-input=10; changed to 9, saved via scope-pricing-save-btn, reload-nav confirms persisted 9, reset to 10 saved. (7) Sales tier (testsalesadmin) N2 labor repeat → range only $3,950–$6,200 (brackets owner's $5,850), no scope-final-value, no scope-deposit-value, no 'Labor · … × $' price build, no 'Trip fee' line, no lb weight figures, no scope-margin-toggle, only band $ figures on page; scope-labor-no-truck present. (8) Household regression 2BR truck (miles=30) → Household mode, range $1,425–$1,625, truck SVG rendered, no crash. No JS errors on any page (401s on Airtable are expected without AIRTABLE_API_KEY).
critical_code_review_comments: ScopeCalculator.jsx is 1045 lines — still trending upward. Consider extracting RoomsCard, ItemsCard, AccessCard, PriceBuildCard, and OutputPanel subcomponents; the main file has 7+ discrete surfaces and 500+ lines of JSX which slows reviewer + Playwright authoring.

Room tier chips (—/Light/Avg/Packed) still lack per-cell data-testids; testing has to walk the DOM structurally and matches by textContent. Adding testids like scope-room-{k}-tier-{i} (or scope-room-{k}-avg-btn) would harden automation.

Saved-scopes list still has no inline delete/rename control; the TEST_QA Assessment 800lb row this run adds a third TEST_ scope to preview and can only be pruned via DB. Owner-only trash icon would help.
Sidebar label is 'Scope Calculator' but the review spec / page title use 'Job Scope Calculator' — minor label drift, not blocking.

success_rate.backend: n/a (skipped per request — engine node-tests 52/52 and pytest 21 pass per prior iterations)

seed_data_creation: Created one saved scope 'TEST_QA Assessment 800lb' on the owner account (specialty-only, 800lb+ band, assessment_required). No inline delete UI, safe to leave or main agent may prune from DB. maxHoursOnSite temporarily flipped 10→9→10 and confirmed to persist across nav.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0-1..P0-5 Deploy 1 acceptance verified live. Reusable helpers: (a) login by data-testid login-username-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button, then wait for 'a[href="/scope-calculator"]' to become clickable before nav (session cookie takes ~1s). (b) Room tier chip: page.evaluate to walk 'div.grid.grid-cols-1' rows, match nested button[aria-expanded] textContent to room name, then click sibling button[aria-pressed] with matching tier textContent ('—'|'Light'|'Avg'|'Packed'). (c) Steppers (room count, item qty, stairs): page.get_by_role('button', name=f'More {label}', exact=True), where label matches ACCESS.n / ROOMS.n / ITEMS.n (e.g. 'Flights of stairs — pickup', 'Standard bedroom', 'Upright piano'). (d) Settings pricing save button = scope-pricing-save-btn. (e) Sales POV lands on /leads; nav sidebar has Scope Calculator entry via assignedCalc. Deploy 2 P1/P2 items (commercial mode, payload-overage choice, long-distance banner, capacity guardrail banners, clearance-blank prompt, deep-link session fix, stepper rapid-click, calibration loop) are NOT built and should not be tested. Known P2-3 bug: hard-loading /scope-calculator or /settings by URL bounces to login — always click sidebar entries after logging in at '/'.
